why: The 3-dimensional case of the symmetric Mahler conjecture (matching the stated problem, centrally symmetric convex bodies) appears to have been proved by Chen, Li, Xi, and Xu in a May 2026 arXiv preprint using a 'shadow flow' method, extending the general (non-symmetric) case as well; this settles a specific dimension of the conjecture while the general n-dimensional case remains open.
queries: Mahler's conjecture solved OR disproved arXiv
Mahler conjecture symmetric convex body 2025 2026 progress
